# ex_syslogger v2.2.0 - Table of Contents

> ExSyslogger is an Elixir Logger custom backend to syslog.

## Modules

- [ExSyslogger](https://ex-syslogger.hexdocs.pm/ExSyslogger.md): ExSyslogger is custom backend for Elixir Logger that logs to syslog by wrapping `erlang-syslog`.
- [ExSyslogger.JsonFormatter](https://ex-syslogger.hexdocs.pm/ExSyslogger.JsonFormatter.md): JsonFormatter is formatter that produces a properly JSON object string where the level, message, node, and metadata are JSON object root properties.
